model_annotation: This pie chart illustrates the distribution of samples across varying values of sample-level maximum ambiguity. The chart contains six slices, each colored a distinct shade of blue, representing the proportions of data categorized into different ambiguity levels: 0.64 is approximately 0.24%, 0.68 is approximately 0.46%, 0.72 is approximately 0.6%, 0.76 is approximately 0.4%, 0.8 is approximately 0.23%, and 0.84 is approximately 0.03%.  The chart includes percentage labels inside each slice, and the slices appear ordered from smallest to largest proportion, indicating a descending order of ambiguity values. A legend is not included, and none of the slices are visually emphasized.
